about_the_game:
🦊 4Story : The Original – Nine-Tailed Fox Mount Pack

Unleash mystical elegance with the legendary Nine-Tailed Fox mounts!
Choose your favorite spirit companion and travel the world of Iveria in style.

Included Mounts:

  • White Nine-Tailed Fox (Permanent)
    A graceful fox spirit with snow-white fur. Its swift steps and serene presence make it a loyal companion on every journey.

  • Black Nine-Tailed Fox (Permanent)
    A mysterious fox spirit cloaked in midnight fur. Silent, agile, and bound to its chosen rider.

  • Cyan Nine-Tailed Fox (Permanent)
    A rare fox spirit shimmering with pale blue hues. Its ethereal glow hints at ancient magic flowing through its tails.

*Please note that you must enter your 4Story : The Original client, open the premium shop and click on the DLC banner to acquire this DLC package.
